note: Jerome County, ID publishes its zoning only as a 2023 PDF zoning map (county Zoning Maps and GIS pages). The City of Jerome publishes its zoning only as PDF maps (Sept 2023 map, Jan 2024 map, Feb 2021 map). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the Idaho state REST directories found no queryable Jerome County or City of Jerome zoning district layer. The county GIS server could not be reached. Only the parcel map and public lands map are online as viewers.
